text_block_list.text: Right after starting our roadwork around the training lodge—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Trainer-san,
is it about time for a break, yes?
choice_data_list: I only just got started, though...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can't wait for recreation time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The ocean is right in front of us! You can't blame
me for wanting to go for a swim, no sir-ee!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"That does it, I am Over The Patience!
Let's go swimming, SHOWTIME!!"
choice_data_list: Then shall we do some training at the beach?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
I totally agree with training at the beach!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Will you swim against the waves!?
Or maybe race against a dolphin!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "I can do anything, YES! Let me go change my clothes, OK?!"

Afterward, Taiki Shuttle channeled
her desire to play straight into
her training at the beach.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see!
If we finish early, we can go swimming sooner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's crush
this training with pure guts!
Afterward, with her mind set on hurrying off to play, Taiki Shuttle powered through her training in no time.
